newsitem.title: USA: Utah Medical sees Columbia buy boosting EPS.
newsitem.headline: Utah Medical sees Columbia buy boosting EPS.

text.p: Utah Medical Products Inc said on Tuesday that its recent acquisition of Columbia Medical Inc should add $0.03 to $0.04 per share to its earnings performance for the rest of 1997, as well as an incremental $0.10 per share in 19998.

"Even though future reported combined performance will be reduced by amortization of goodwill and interest costs until UM eliminates debt which resulted from the purchase, we expect that the acquisition of Columbia Medical Inc should add 3-4 cents per share for the balance of 1997," said chief executive Kevin Cornwell.
He added that the purchase gives Utah Medical a stable base of business of about $7 million per calendar quarter.
